description: vcruz305's one-Spark GLM-5.3-Flash lane on vLLM (GLM-5.3-Flash-SAGE-REXL3-DGX-Spark-recipe at f1d5dfa1, his final spec server): his gated-by-card SAGE REXL3 2.48 bpw pack (96.5 GiB resident, mul1 codebook, mixed K per layer; the files download anonymously) served through vLLM main (2026-10-22 snapshot of the minimax-m31-flash image), the vllm-exl3 plugin and his exllamav3 fork, with Inco AI's DFlash2 draft (5 speculative tokens, probabilistic draft sampling, standard rejection) at the full 262,144-token window, one concurrent request, 2,048 batched tokens, a 6.25 GiB KV pool, the glm45 reasoning and tool-call parsers and image and video input (the pack's processor_config configures a video processor and the launch sets no video limit). His in-container patches (loader fixes for dense EXL3 linears, a shrunken dummy draft embedding, a disjoint-slab draft KV planner and an indexer workspace right-size) are applied at build time. The pack's config.json declares only quant_method exl3; the vllm-exl3 loader needs the per-layer expert K and the dense EXL3 linears declared, which his local overlay directory held and his scripts do not publish. The launcher therefore derives the declaration from the pack's tensor headers (the method of the plugin's native-pack tool) into a symlink overlay under the cache and runs his own overlay self-test before vLLM starts; the overlay is reconstructed from the pack, not the creator's own. Upstream claims, not measured here: 19.2 tok/s autoregressive decode at any window, 41.15 tok/s with DFlash2 K5 at 124K depth (2.1x), prefill 496 to 559 tok/s falling to about 444 to 484 at 259K (about 9 to 10 minutes to first token for a full window), a needle at 50 percent of a 124K haystack found, GSM8K-100 94/100 and HumanEval-50 47/50 greedy with thinking off, and a MemAvailable of 2.40 GiB after CUDA graph capture; the creator runs a host guard that kills the server below 0.5 GiB MemAvailable, and two earlier 262K boots tripped it at 0.48 and 0.499 GiB. The declared peak is the admission maximum, 124.45 GB; his own figure (total memory less that 2.40 GiB, 128.09 GB) is above the admission maximum; the Controller tries an over-maximum estimate alone on an empty Spark, and the hardware try measures it. The creator ran his container with seccomp unconfined, unlimited memlock and a 112 GB memory limit; this recipe asks for none of them. Licences are informational: the recipe code is AGPL-3.0-only, the pack and GLM-5.3-Flash are MIT, and the DFlash2 draft is Apache-2.0 (relicensed by IncoAI at its current head, after the revision this recipe pins).
title: GLM 5.3 Flash SAGE REXL3 2.48bpw + DFlash2 vLLM single Spark (vcruz305)
